description: Per-selector vectors of the extended register rows. Each vector is the exact reply frame data a read receives, with the native outcome the frozen poller produced for it: its own reader or decoder at the acquisition seam, the native value, the payload the read returned, the request it sent, the diagnostic lines it logged, the number of sends and the time of the first send.
recorder: A same-package test in a scratch copy of the frozen gateway package, never committed: for every row and decode it builds a fresh poller whose send function returns the frame bytes, whose clock and pause are scripted, and calls the poller's own reader. Call-site expressions that are inline in the poller's refresh functions are transcribed in the recorder with the same operands.
